labels.reasoning: This is an air hand (JsTs with no draw on 8c5d2h rainbow dry board — no straight draw since JT needs 9 and 7 to make a straight, and 8-5-2 doesn't connect; draw_outs=0, has_straight_draw=0). Hero is IP but has 0.14 equity, better_hand_pct=0.89 meaning nearly 90% of villain range beats this hand. villain_air_pct=0.56 is high, but pure bluffs 3-way are unprofitable per KB §1.1 — need both opponents to fold. With no draw equity and 14% equity total, betting is a pure bluff into two opponents with only 56% combined air. SPR is compressed at 1.33. Checking keeps hero's 14% equity intact without commitment.

This is a drawing hand (Td9d on Jd8d3h — nut flush draw + open-ended straight draw = combo draw with 17 outs, draw_outs=17). Hero faces CO c-bet of 33 into 90 (pot odds 26.8%) with 55% equity well above the 26.8% needed. However, KB §1.7 semi-bluff RAISE requires nut draw + blocker — hero's Td9d is a nut flush draw (has Ad? No — hero holds Td9d, not the Ad; flush draw rank is 10, not 14). Without the Ace-of-suit blocker, the nut-FD raise carve-out does not apply per KB §1.7. CALL is correct: equity far exceeds pot odds, combo draw is strong, and calling preserves equity realization. villain_air_pct=0.30 is notable but not sufficient for RAISE without the nut blocker.

This is an air/busted-draw hand (9s8s on QsJd5h2c6c river — river is 6c completing to five-board, hero has a straight draw remaining draw_outs=4 but raw_equity=0.00 meaning no realized equity). Hero has no showdown value and no made hand. villain_checked_back=1 shows weakness, but hero has no equity to bluff with on the river when 94% of villain range beats this busted draw. This is a monster hand (Tc9c on QhJs8d — flopped straight with 83.5% equity, is_monster=1). This is an air/drawing hand (AhTc on QdJc4s — no pair, gutshot only with draw_outs=4, has_straight_draw=1, OOP). Despite moderate air (0.42), fold equity 3-way requires both opponents to fold, and gutshot without pair provides insufficient equity. CHECK and realize equity cheaply or fold to action.

CHECK is preferred: with near-zero fold equity and a value-dense villain range, IP check-behind preserves pot control and keeps the pot manageable while maintaining equity advantage on later streets.
